raw_response:
Well, it's that time of year again. My wheat went in last October — around the 8th or so, a bit earlier than some because the weather was good and I wanted to get it done before it got too cold. I used seed I kept from last year, mostly, bought a little from the village seed shop to top up. Didn't buy the fancy hybrid wheat seed, too expensive and honestly my saved seed does fine. My wife and I put down about one bag of that compound fertilizer per mu at planting, same as always — 50 kilos a mu, the NPK kind. Cost a bit more this year but what can you do.

Now it's spring and the wheat is coming up green. I already gave it the returning green water in March when it was looking a bit dry. My brother-in-law works in the city but he came back to help for a few days, so we managed. I just topdressed the jointing fertilizer about ten days ago — half a bag of urea per mu, so about 25 kilos. I do this because I tried skipping it one year and the yield was poor, maybe only 350 kilos a mu. Never again. I irrigated after that too. I'll probably need one more water at grain filling in May, and then we harvest in early June. I expect about 450 kilos per mu if the weather holds. I sprayed herbicide once in the spring, and I'll keep an eye out for bugs. No disease problems last year so I'm not doing fungicide unless I see something.

The maize will go in right after the wheat comes off — mid-June, maybe June 15th if the weather is good. I always buy hybrid maize seed, can't really save it. Costs me about 45 yuan a mu but it's worth it. I'll rotary till quick after the wheat harvest — the window is tight, maybe five days, but my cousin has a machine and he does mine right after his. For fertilizer, I'll put down compound fertilizer at planting, about 40 kilos a mu, and then topdress with urea at the big喇叭口 stage, around 15 kilos a mu. I might irrigate once or twice for the maize depending on rain. Last year was dry and I watered twice, this year who knows. I usually spray herbicide once and that's it for maize, unless the armyworms show up like two years ago — that was bad, I had to spray insecticide twice.

My household has six people but my younger brother and his wife both work off-farm in Shijiazhuang, so it's mostly me, my wife, and my parents doing the farm work. We hire maybe 10-15 days of labor total for the busy times — wheat harvest and maize planting especially. Costs about 120 yuan a day now. We don't have a lot of extra cash, so I don't go crazy on inputs. I know Old Zhang down the road puts on more fertilizer but he borrows money for it. I don't like owing money. Better to be a bit safe.

Total cost this year I figure around 9,000 yuan or so for everything on the 20 mu. If wheat gets me 450 kg/mu and maize gets me 500 kg/mu, and prices hold, we should do alright. Not getting rich, but feeding the family and putting some aside.
